title: Machine learning and multi-omics-based identification of hub paternal imprinted genes PEG11/RTL1, PEG9/DLK1, PEG6/NDN, and PEG5/NNAT in sperm of couples experiencing idiopathic recurrent pregnancy loss.
authors: Hashemi Karoii, Danial; Najafi, S Mahmoud A; Favaedi, Raha; Esmaeili Borzabadi, Vahid; Sabbaghian, Marjan; Amirchaghmaghi, Elham; Shahhoseini, Maryam
one_liner_zh: 该研究利用机器学习与多组学识别精子中父源印记基因作为复发性流产生物标志物，虽涉及基因表达与甲基化，但核心是临床表型关联而非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，方法上仅用机器学习分类，无AI/物理模拟的互作机制研究。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Idiopathic recurrent pregnancy loss (IRPL), defined as two or more consecutive pregnancy losses without an identifiable cause, affects 1-2 % of couples in their reproductive years. While maternal factors have been extensively studied, paternal contributions remain underexplored. Paternally imprinted genes are essential for spermatogenesis, embryonic development, and placental function, and their epigenetic dysregulation may contribute to IRPL. RESULTS: Single-cell RNA-seq analysis highlighted RTL1, DLK1, NDN, and NNAT as hub paternal imprinted genes specifically enriched in spermatogenic lineages. In sperm samples, PEG11/RTL1, PEG9/DLK1, and PEG5/NNAT showed significantly reduced expression, whereas PEG6/NDN was upregulated in the IRPL group. DNA methylation assays revealed hypermethylation of PEG11/RTL1, PEG9/DLK1, and PEG5/NNAT and hypomethylation of PEG6/NDN in IRPL cases. Machine learning-based consensus models achieved high predictive accuracy, with the Random Survival Forest model performing best (average AUC = 0.747). Functional enrichment analyses linked these genes to key biological processes including glucose transport, VEGF receptor signaling, and placental development. CONCLUSIONS: Our findings demonstrate that aberrant expression and methylation of paternal imprinted genes-particularly PEG11/RTL1, PEG9/DLK1, PEG6/NDN, and PEG5/NNAT-play a critical role in IRPL. By integrating multi-omics data with machine learning, this study provides novel insights into paternal genetic and epigenetic contributions to recurrent pregnancy loss and identifies potential biomarkers for diagnosis and therapeutic targets for intervention.
abstract_zh: 背景：特发性复发性妊娠丢失（IRPL），定义为两次或以上连续妊娠丢失且无明确原因，影响1-2%的育龄期夫妇。虽然母体因素已被广泛研究，但父方贡献仍未充分探索。父源印记基因对精子发生、胚胎发育和胎盘功能至关重要，其表观遗传失调可能促成IRPL。结果：单细胞RNA-seq分析突出显示RTL1、DLK1、NDN和NNAT为富集于精子发生谱系的核心父源印记基因。在精子样本中，PEG11/RTL1、PEG9/DLK1和PEG5/NNAT表达显著降低，而PEG6/NDN在IRPL组中上调。DNA甲基化检测显示，IRPL病例中PEG11/RTL1、PEG9/DLK1和PEG5/NNAT呈高甲基化，PEG6/NDN呈低甲基化。基于机器学习的共识模型实现了高预测准确性，其中随机生存森林模型表现最佳（平均AUC = 0.747）。功能富集分析将这些基因与关键生物过程相关联，包括葡萄糖转运、VEGF受体信号传导和胎盘发育。结论：我们的研究结果表明，父源印记基因的异常表达和甲基化——特别是PEG11/RTL1、PEG9/DLK1、PEG6/NDN和PEG5/NNAT——在IRPL中发挥关键作用。通过将多组学数据与机器学习相结合，本研究为父方遗传和表观遗传对复发性妊娠丢失的贡献提供了新见解，并识别了诊断的潜在生物标志物和干预的治疗靶点。
